protocol.baseline_outcome: Research turn limit reached after four tool-producing research turns; no report.
protocol.question: How do working-capital movements and investment commitments affect confidence in durable cash generation? Separate realized company-wide cash flows, accounting changes, and attributed management expectations.
protocol.allowance_scope: Existing shared portfolio ledger; no reset, refund, or budget increase.

prior_memory.policy: Exact frozen prior reviewed memory from the baseline investigation; no intervening drafts.

measurement: Report produced within four research requests
Only missing prerequisite tools offered on last gathering request
All returned tools declared by the frozen request before any tool executes
Critic outcome and independent substantive review
All attempts, estimated usage cost, unknown usage, permanent reservations
protocol.publication: No automatic review, export, or deployment. Raw provider responses and source text remain private.
protocol.comparison_limit: One new proof after two observed failures, with a deliberately changed action policy. Same question and starting evidence do not establish a causal quality improvement or cost saving.
protocol.last_gathering_tools: Only missing prerequisite categories: read_source, calculate, save_hypothesis. Model chooses relevant arguments; no dummy checks. With none missing, synthesize early without tools.
protocol.stop_after_this_proof: No further paid protocols, replacement investigations, or enlarged limits after this result.

outcome.independent_content_review: Qualifications required before publication; critic pass is not substantive approval.
outcome.interpretation: This run completed the structural prerequisites and produced a report, unlike the two earlier attempts. One follow-up does not establish a causal policy effect or adequate research quality. No further paid protocol or editorial request was started.
